sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

For example, the bird can fly slowly and steadily through narrow tunnels, or quickly and aggressively through wide spaces. Another key mechanic in Flappy Wings is the bird's gravity. The bird can move up and down through the air, and the player must use this movement to their advantage.
